title: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP and SAP Web Dispatcher do not sufficiently validate certain header values…
description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP and SAP Web Dispatcher have a vulnerability where certain header values are not sufficiently validated during inbound request handling. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this by sending a specially crafted request that causes the affected process to become unavailable, impacting availability but not confidentiality or integrity.
